method.worker_order: same interpreter; alternate versions per workload per CPU batch
method.scope: saved Consumer fixture CPU costs; not provider or production latency
method.comparison: only outputs equal to their independent reference receive a release ratio
method.distribution_metadata: worker package versions describe installed distributions; source hashes identify selected code
method.native_probe: observed Python-to-C entries; a native guard's delegated orjson call is not fabricated as an orjson profiling event
method.native_spacing: the native spaced encoder must independently return the exact default-source reference bytes; entry followed by fallback does not satisfy this probe
method.native_dispatch: profiling restores Python function frames; separate untimed binding and readiness probes attest native dispatch after one output-checked warm call

publication_normalization.note: Consumer labels, artifact paths and machine-specific origins normalized for public publication. Historical timings, measured payload bytes and original source digests retain their captured meaning; normalized source/archive bytes have their own publication hashes.
